name: Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship
amount: Tuition-free + HUF 43,700/month (BA/MA) or HUF 140,000–180,000/month (PhD), free dorm or HUF 40,000/month housing contribution, medical insurance

eligibility.note: Applicants with Hungarian ancestors who are citizens of eligible countries (practically all countries except EU member states, Serbia and Ukraine's Zakarpattia Oblast)

fields: Most fields (degree, exchange and Hungarian preparatory programmes)
note: Stipendium Hungaricum-style package for the Hungarian diaspora outside the Carpathian Basin; some allowances are paid on request. Check the annual call for the exact country list.

name: Polonista NAWA Programme (students and doctoral candidates)
host: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
dlText: Expected ~3 Apr 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Foreign students and doctoral candidates (non-Polish nationals) interested in Polish language and culture, typically enrolled in Polish/Slavic studies abroad

fields: Polish studies, Polish language and culture
note: Funds a one- or two-semester study stay at a Polish university for foreign students of Polish studies.
